lead.headline: Ugly Counts the Same

sidebar.title: The Whole League Bricked

10-8.headline: From 0–3 to Kingslayers

1-7.headline: Chimpanzini Takes Down No. 4
1-7.text: {S1} hung the week's second-best score, all-play 10–1, and dragged the No. 4 team down from 4–1. {S7}'s perfect lineup would have lost too, by 14.36.

12-6.headline: Zero at QB, Lost by Inches
12-6.text: {S6} started Lamar Jackson, projected for zero, and got exactly that. Second straight loss, now 2–4. {S12} escaped with its season low.

9-3.headline: Four Zeros and an 0–6
9-3.text: {S3} started four players who scored zero and posted the season's lowest score. Six games, six losses, zero excuses. {S9} never had to break a sweat.
